recipe.visualDefinition: A dramatic low-key portrait of a male figure emerging from a total black void. The lighting is highly directional, catching only the highlights of a leather trench coat, a large ornate gold chain, and the facial features, while leaving the majority of the frame in absolute shadow.
coreVisualRelationships: Hard light vs. absolute black void
Specular highlights on leather vs. matte skin tones
Gold metallic luster vs. monochromatic dark palette
Verticality of the figure vs. expansive negative space
coreInvariants: High-contrast directional lighting from the upper left
Visible texture on leather and jewelry

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is vertically oriented, slightly off-center to the left, occupying approximately 40% of the horizontal frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, reflective gold medallion and chain serve as the primary focal point due to their brightness and central placement.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bright jewelry, moves upward to the partially lit face, then follows the highlights down the length of the leather coat.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant negative space (approx 60-70%) consisting of pure black, creating a sense of isolation and intensity.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely low saturation overall, with high value contrast between the highlights and the background.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with dreadlocks wearing a black leather trench coat and a large gold chain. Use a single hard light source from the side to create deep shadows. The background must be pure, solid black with no visible floor or walls.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a minimalist sans-serif or a sharp serif font in white or gold, placed in the negative space to the right of the subject.

verificationChecks: Are the highlights on the leather sharp and reflective?
Is the jewelry the brightest point in the image?

adjustableVariables: Length and texture of the leather coat
mustRedesign: Any visible background elements like walls or floors
Soft, even lighting that eliminates shadows
postGenerationChecks: Check for absolute black levels in the background.
Ensure the gold chain has metallic luster.
Verify the leather coat has distinct specular highlights.
Confirm the face is partially obscured by shadow.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key studio lighting + black leather texture + metallic gold focal point + absolute black void background.
